title: Calling the Instalment Due on a Vacation Package
content:
The instalment called on a vacation package is what the package still owes, called in one payment. A party holding a package under any of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products may ask to pay what is now called on it, and the money is taken from the card the package was booked with.

The instalment called on a package is fixed only after the package ledger carries the amendment charge owed for every change the operations desk has approved against the package.

## What the payment does

The payment puts a single balance-payment line on that package's ledger for the amount released, dated the day it is taken, and raises the net money standing to the package by that amount, so the outstanding figure on the party's package statement falls by the same amount.

## How the payment is made

The tool `settle_package_instalment_b6602c09` is unlocked and handed over to the customer themselves, who runs it on their own package; the desk does not run it for them.

## What it is given

- `bundle_package_id` — the internal reference number identifying which of the party's vacation packages the money is being paid against, as carried on the package record the desk reads out to them. It is an identifier and carries no set of fixed candidates.
- `instalment_amount_usd` — the money released on this occasion, given as a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, with no currency symbol, thousands separator or sign; it is always a positive money value, and carries no set of fixed candidates.

## What comes back

A plain confirmation sentence naming the new package ledger line reference, the package paid against and the amount taken in US dollars to two decimal places. That sentence, carrying a ledger line reference, is the party's receipt for the payment; no other value is returned.
